seoCopy: Midnight Grace is a restrained black blouse design with delicate maroon and antique-gold Aari embroidery, subtle scattered motifs and matching neckline and sleeve borders. Its listed work type includes Aari embroidery, gold threadwork and bead embellishment; the exact thread fibre and bead composition are not specified and can be discussed before ordering. The dark base makes the metallic and maroon details visible without relying on dense coverage. Consider pairing it with a black, maroon, antique-gold or deep red saree, checking the zari, pallu and jewellery together for a balanced result. The listed starting price is ₹1,999 for hand embroidery on a customer-supplied blouse or garment. It excludes the garment, courier and any additional material changes beyond the listed design. This listing does not state a guaranteed completion period. Send the event date, garment readiness and any requested changes with your enquiry so the studio can review the scope and confirm a realistic crafting timeline based on current workload.
summary: An elegant black blouse featuring delicate maroon and antique-gold Aari embroidery with subtle scattered motifs.
description: Midnight Grace brings understated elegance through a deep black fabric base, intricate maroon and antique-gold embroidery, and delicate scattered embellishments. The neckline features a beautifully detailed embroidered border, complemented by matching sleeve borders and subtle metallic motifs across the blouse. The back showcases a wide U-shaped neckline with decorative tie strings and tassel detailing.
